items.question: How do I get demos for a Shopify app beyond the app store?
items.answer: Reach the merchants directly. App store listings mostly bring small stores on free plans, so we pick established brands by size, category and growth stage and contact the founder or the person who owns the problem your app solves. For one Shopify app company this booked 27 product demos, with a 39% LinkedIn connection acceptance rate.

items.question: Who should we contact at a D2C brand: the founder or someone else?
items.answer: It depends on what your product fixes. Logistics and fulfilment tools sell to operations heads and supply chain managers, retention and CRM platforms to CRM or lifecycle leads, and analytics products to growth and revenue leaders. Founders sign at smaller brands. We split the list by role and write a separate message for each group.

items.question: Our product is technical. How do you explain it to non-technical buyers?
items.answer: We translate features into the business result the buyer already tracks, such as acquisition cost, repeat purchase, delivery times or marketplace sales. For an eCommerce analytics platform with technical positioning, outreach and founder content built around those outcomes booked 15 qualified sales meetings and 3 late-stage product opportunities.

items.question: Do you sell to shoppers or run consumer marketing?
items.answer: No. We only run B2B outreach to the businesses that would buy your product: D2C brands, marketplace sellers and online retailers. We don't run ads, consumer email or marketing to shoppers. Every contact is a founder, operations, CRM or growth leader at a brand, reached through cold email, LinkedIn and your founder's content.

items.question: How soon will we see the first demos?
items.answer: Campaigns usually go live about 18 days after onboarding, and first qualified conversations typically come in weeks 3 to 4. In one eCommerce SaaS campaign, 28 qualified meetings were booked within 6 weeks. Timing is not guaranteed; it depends on your market, your list and how quickly brands review new tools.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We book the demos; your team runs them and closes the deal.
